transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we finalize the rollout. While tracing a separate permissions bug yesterday, I found that 23 legacy admin endpoints update permissions without emitting the invalidation event that the new cache consumes. I haven't filed the adapter work yet because I was still confirming which endpoints use that path. The rollout plan must include a binding commitment to build and verify an invalidation adapter for those 23 endpoints before we expand beyond the initial cohort.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the load rehearsal I ran this morning. Invalidation-queue propagation measured at a 9-minute p95, and the queue stays within its safe operating limit only if the first rollout cohort is capped at 10 percent. Additionally, the authorization cache lifetime must be set to exactly 300 seconds for this rollout. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the rehearsal finished after the change-control review began.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share a finding from a support-case review I completed. All 11 SCIM-managed enterprise accounts use an admin workflow that cannot yet explain delayed permission changes. Those accounts must be excluded from the first rollout cohort, and a support playbook must be prepared before they are enabled. I hadn't posted this earlier because the cases were being reassigned between support queues.
transcript.speaker: A4
